entries.text: Cats have over 20 vocalizations, including the purr, meow, and chirp.
A group of cats is called a clowder.
Cats spend 70% of their lives sleeping.
A cat's hearing is much more sensitive than a human's or dog's.
Cats can rotate their ears 180 degrees.
The first cat in space was a French cat named Felicette in 1963.
Cats have a specialized collarbone that allows them to always land on their feet.
A cat's nose print is unique, like a human fingerprint.
Cats can jump up to six times their length.
The oldest known pet cat was found in a 9,500-year-old grave on Cyprus.
The Sun is about 4.6 billion years old.
A day on Venus is longer than a year on Venus.
There are more stars in the universe than grains of sand on Earth.
Neutron stars can spin 600 times per second.
One million Earths could fit inside the Sun.
The footprints on the Moon will remain for 100 million years.
Saturn's density is low enough that it would float in water.
A teaspoon of neutron star would weigh about 6 billion tons.
The largest known star, UY Scuti, could fit 5 billion Suns.
Olympus Mons on Mars is the largest volcano in the solar system.
Honey never spoils. Archaeologists found 3000-year-old honey in Egyptian tombs.
Octopuses have three hearts and blue blood.
Bananas are berries, but strawberries are not.
A jiffy is an actual unit of time: 1/100th of a second.
The Eiffel Tower can grow by 15 cm during hot days.
Sharks have been around longer than trees.
There are more possible chess games than atoms in the observable universe.
Cows have best friends and get stressed when separated.
The inventor of the Pringles can is buried in one.
A cloud can weigh more than a million pounds.
Scotland's national animal is the unicorn.
Wombat poop is cube-shaped.
The heart of a shrimp is located in its head.
A group of flamingos is called a flamboyance.
Elephants are the only animals that can't jump.
Polar bear fur is not white – it's transparent.
Sloths can hold their breath longer than dolphins.
The shortest war in history lasted 38 to 45 minutes.
The first oranges weren't orange – they were green.
Your brain uses about 20% of your total energy.
Dolphins sleep with one eye open.
The average person walks the equivalent of three times around the world in a lifetime.
A bolt of lightning is five times hotter than the surface of the Sun.
There are more trees on Earth than stars in the Milky Way.
Humans share 60% of their DNA with bananas.
The longest hiccuping spree lasted 68 years.
Venus is the only planet that spins clockwise.
A single lightning bolt can power 150,000 homes for a minute.
The Great Wall of China is not visible from space with the naked eye.
Koalas sleep up to 22 hours a day.
